items.item:
- INV-040: the progress manual value check: an administrator and an assigned
  operator are admitted to `portal.progress.manage`, a viewer and a producer
  are refused; `set_section_progress` stores 0, 37 and 100 and refuses
  values outside [0, 100] and non-integers with every table unchanged;
  publishing and updating photos leave `section_progress` and the progress
  view unchanged
  [witness: verification:progress_manual_value_client_portal].
statements: INV-040: completion percent is a manual staff value in [0,100]; photographs never set progress

verdicts.item:
- INV-040: the progress manual value check: an administrator and an assigned
  operator are admitted to `portal.progress.manage`, a viewer and a producer
  are refused; `set_section_progress` stores 0, 37 and 100 and refuses
  values outside [0, 100] and non-integers with every table unchanged;
  publishing and updating photos leave `section_progress` and the progress
  view unchanged
  [witness: verification:progress_manual_value_client_portal].
statements: INV-040: completion percent is a manual staff value in [0,100]; photographs never set progress
quotes: witness.expect_raises(errors, call, f"{label} must be refused")
witness.expect(not changed, f"{label}: the refusal wrote to {changed}")
witness.expect(stored.completion_percent == value, f"{value} was stored as {stored.completion_percent}")
row is not None and row.completion_percent == value and row.updated_by == OPERATOR_ID,
witness.expect(not untracked, f"a photo created progress for an untracked section: {untracked}")
verdicts.why: The check admits the administrator and assigned operator, refuses the viewer and producer without any table changes, stores 0, 37, and 100, and rejects representative out-of-range and non-integer values while comparing every table. It also asserts that publishing, replaying, and updating photos neither changes section_progress or the derived progress view nor creates progress for an untracked section.
